**In one line**: OpenAI's flagship Stargate AI-infrastructure effort in Korea is reportedly stuck at an early phase, with Samsung Electronics and SK showing little visible progress.

### Key points
- The Korean portion of OpenAI's large-scale Stargate data-center initiative has reportedly yet to move past its starting phase.
- Named partners Samsung Electronics and SK have shared little concrete progress, according to Korea JoongAng Daily.
- The scope — spanning chip and memory supply plus data-center buildout — is broad, which appears to be slowing detailed agreements.

### Why it matters
Stargate is OpenAI's push to build the outsized infrastructure needed for next-generation AI training and services, and Korean chipmakers' involvement bears directly on Korea's place in the global AI supply chain. The reported delay underscores how large AI-infrastructure commitments can be slower to execute than they are to announce.
